title: SEO
lead: This controls how Google, AI tools and social media see the site. Most people never need to change it. Only the owner can see this screen.

serviceRegion.label: Region name
serviceRegion.note: A wider area, like Central Florida. It is listed first.

shareImage.label: Picture shown when the site is shared
shareImage.note: If you pick nothing, the first gallery photo is used.

allowAiCrawlers.label: Let ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and other AI tools read the site

from.label: Old address (starts with /)
from.patternMessage: The old address needs to start with a slash, like /old-page.

to.label: New address (starts with / or https://)
to.patternMessage: The new address needs to start with / or https://.

siteUrl.label: Main web address
siteUrl.patternMessage: Use the full address starting with https:// and no slash at the end.
siteUrl.note: Used for the sitemap and search engine links. Change it only if the domain changes.
